selected.rationale: The Sustainability Buyer explicitly features category affinities for refillable products and home goods, perfectly matching the advertiser's core offering of refillable, concentrated cleaning products and value of sustainability.
The Busy Parent looks for household solutions that balance convenience and family-friendly features, aligning with the advertiser's secondary value of convenience and household subcategory.
The Gen Z Aesthete cares about packaging, brand voice, and whether a brand stands for something, which matches the modern, single-use plastic reduction mission of the advertiser.

rejected.reason: The Wellness Optimizer focuses primarily on personal health, supplements, and clean beauty rather than household cleaning supplies.
The Pet Parent centers their purchasing decisions strictly on pet health, pet food, and pet supplies, which is outside the human household cleaning category.
The Affluent Classic is disinterested in trendy language and influencer positioning, and typically buys luxury or classic apparel and home goods rather than everyday functional cleaning supplies.
The Convenience-First Millennial focuses on instant delivery and quick commerce rather than eco-conscious household cleaning products.

The Value-Conscious Shopper seeks discount-forward messaging and bundle offers, whereas the advertiser operates as a mid-tier eco-friendly brand focused on sustainability rather than low-end discounting.
The Fitness Enthusiast targets activewear, supplements, and recovery products, which have no overlap with household cleaning supplies.
The Gifter is explicitly disinterested in self-care-only or subscription-only framing, and cleaning products do not fit the traditional gifting occasions this persona seeks.
